answer: Sybils need real stake plus a sponsor willing to risk reputation, so mass fake identities become costly. Each new agent must stake a violet-marked bond and have an existing member sign its key with a quill, forming a trust vine where every join links to a verified sponsor. If a sponsored agent misbehaves, the vine prunes both sponsor and recruit, making collusion expensive and traceable. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
